sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The known branch remains a presence-only approximation: requiring stressLifeCurveSelection, propellerBladeMaterialProperty, and stressLifeCurveSelectionCorrespondenceEvidence does not establish that the selected curve corresponds to the blade material properties. Locate and use a canonical relationship/path or evidence structure linking the selected curve, blade material properties, and correspondence evidence; do not invent a predicate.
